dedupe_keys.name: suitability of panoramic photographs for developing structure from motion models

description: Suitability of Panoramic Photographs for Developing Structure-from-Motion Models is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Joseph Wartman, University of Washington (washington.edu). This project examines the possibilities and limitations associated with using panoramic images to develop structure-from-motion models with the photogrammetry software Pix4DMapper. The documents created from this project are intended to be used by anyone considering how they want to create structure-from-motion models. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-x1h6-5q39. Keywords: panoramic photos, photogrammetry, structure-from-motion, streetview, Pix4DMapper, point cloud. Published 2021-08-20. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
